role_model_verdict: No real role/membership model. Admin = email allowlist (server-verified email from Supabase JWT). Client = single client_email/client_user_id column on site00_projects. No project_members table, no invitations table for projects, no per-user role rows.

permission_matrix.status: ENFORCED (ownership) / ROLE SPOOFABLE — a CLIENT_VIEWER can send role:'CLIENT_OWNER' and approve

CAN_VIEW_MESSAGES only; no client messages table/endpoint (only site00_ec_creative_messages, founder EC thread)

api/site00/projects.ts uses canAccessFounderProjectAsOwner (admin-only); but expression-engine.ts:319+ judgments, master-skin.ts:141 approveSkinMigration, campaign-package.ts:102 delete_asset_permanent are unauthenticated

opus-native estimate (token rates) unauthenticated (opus-native.ts:213-240); stripInternalFields in client room (roomService.ts:207)

founder_auth.evidence: Server: email allowlist via verified Supabase JWT (api/_lib/adminAuth.ts:37-62). Hardcoded defaults incl. personal gmail (:10-14) used when ADMIN_EMAILS unset. Client: localStorage-driven guards, preview bypass (AdminGuard.tsx:10).
founder_auth.gap: No DB-backed founder/admin role; env fallback to hardcoded list; UI guard bypass on preview hosts; ~20 API endpoints do not call any auth helper.

client_auth.evidence: Client room/reviews/production/app require bearer (client-project-room.ts:25, client-reviews.ts:38, client-production.ts:30) and ownership via client_email/client_user_id (clientStudio.ts:152-157).
client_auth.gap: Ownership keyed on email string match; single owner per project; role spoofable via body/query; no collaborator membership.

invite.evidence: Only intake invites exist (site00_intake_invites, worldIntakeService.ts:50-134). Project 'invite' is a metadata flag (appService.ts:113-135 client_app_onboarding='INVITE', no email, no token). Email template MAGIC_LINK_REQUESTED wired:false (shared/site00-email/registry/events.ts:63).
invite.gap: No founder->client project invite (token, email, accept step, membership row). Access is implicit: whoever signs in with the matching client_email owns the project.

account_creation.evidence: signUp with email confirmation enforcement (site00CreateAccountActions.ts:118-140; signOutIfSessionEmailUnconfirmed src/utils/supabase.ts:171).
account_creation.gap: Open self-registration (signUp + OTP shouldCreateUser:true); not tied to an invite; no account activation against a pending project invite.

password.evidence: resetPasswordForEmail redirects to /account/settings (site00SignInActions.ts:206-207); Site00ResetPasswordPage.tsx:11 form does preventDefault and never calls supabase.auth.updateUser.
password.gap: Recovery cannot complete; no PASSWORD_RECOVERY event handling.

magic_link.gap: shouldCreateUser:true lets anyone mint accounts; not bound to invite; custom email template not wired.

provider_auth.evidence: No signInWithOAuth; JURNL adapter returns PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED.
provider_auth.gap: Not required for client-ready MVP but absent.

device_security.evidence: IdntySignInSecurityPage.tsx: 2FA NOT AVAILABLE, TRUSTED DEVICES NOT AVAILABLE, sessions 'CURRENT SESSION ONLY'.
device_security.gap: No MFA, device list, session revoke, sign-in audit.

session_handling.evidence: Supabase session + HttpOnly SameSite=Lax refresh cookie (session-cookie.ts:17-22) + HMAC restore (session-restore.ts:27-35). Client guards trust localStorage 'isSignedIn'/'currentUser' and a backup cookie (adminAuth.ts:162-200,543-567).
session_handling.gap: Refresh token stored in long-lived cookie; CORS '*' on all API (server/index.ts:50); UI state can be forged in localStorage (UI-only impact if APIs enforce).

critical_findings: ~20 API handlers mounted in server/routes.ts perform paid provider calls / persistence with no authentication (e.g. api/site00/twin-v2-visual-concept.ts:79, design-asset-reconstruction.ts, opus-native.ts, campaign-package.ts:102 delete_asset_permanent, expression-engine.ts:319, master-skin.ts, brand-family-skin.ts, page-mirror.ts, implementation-snapshots.ts, sol-design-bench.ts, experience-engine.ts, experience-compiler-creative-director.ts, astral-world-assets.ts, astral-world-avatar-library.ts). (vision-replication.ts and hero-asset-materialize.ts are also unauthenticated but NOT mounted in server/routes.ts — reachable only via Vercel file routing or the Vite dev server.)
Client review role is taken from request (api/site00/client-reviews.ts:69-76,122-189 -> reviewService.ts:148,242,287,347,422,492): any project owner-or-collaborator can escalate to CLIENT_OWNER.
getSupabaseAdmin silently falls back to ANON key (api/_lib/supabase.ts:31) — server code assumes RLS bypass.
RLS policies with USING(true) and no TO role on site00_brand_creative_context and site00_page_concept_generation_runs (anon read/write via PostgREST).

verdict.reason: Identity (Supabase JWT) is real and admin APIs under api/admin/* are server-enforced, but there is no role/membership model, no project invite flow, password reset cannot complete, client roles are request-spoofable, and a large set of generation/mutation endpoints are unauthenticated. Not client-ready.
